newsitem.title: USA: B.C. Hydro targets Bennett Dam repairs for May.
newsitem.headline: B.C. Hydro targets Bennett Dam repairs for May.

text.p: Work to repair two large sinkholes at the Bennett Dam in British Columbia is expected to be completed in early May, B.C. Hydro said this week.
Trials of the compaction grouting techique being used to repair the sinkholes, which appeared last summer, are now underway and testing is expected to begin in March.
A spokeswoman for B.C. Hydro said the work will not affect power generation from the project, although the reservoir level has been limited since the sinkholes appeared.
The generating station at Bennett Dam has an installed capacity of 2,730 megawatts.
Bennett, along with the Peace Canyon project just downstream, account for about one-third of B.C. Hydro's total power generation.
